sentences.en: From the consumer smoke test: each scenario is bundled with every third-party module external, so the numbers describe LUC UI's own graph rather than React's. The figures are a snapshot taken on {date}; re-run the command to reproduce them on your machine.
sentences.zh: 数据来自消费端冒烟测试：每个场景都会把全部第三方模块视为外部依赖打包，因此这些数字描述的是 LUC UI 自身的依赖图，而不是 React 的。表中数据为 {date} 的快照；在本机重新运行该命令即可复现。
